BR_Salvagers.text: THE LAUNCH-SHOP / SALVAGERS — smart, clean, capable underdog engineers using maintained older-generation aerospace hardware, rugged adventure equipment and mid-to-late-20th-century retrofuturist forms. Solarwave warmth, canvas, brushed and painted metal, cream, ochre, rust-orange and practical dark accents. Their rockets and vehicles are not garbage piles: they are beautiful legacy machines kept flying through ingenuity.

BR_Tethergrid.text: TETHERGRID CORP — the dominant desert water-and-network utility and operator of the Tetherwell authorization network. Tethergrid began by coordinating scarce water safely across the Mojave, then converted that necessary conservation system into an exploitative subscription monopoly: wells, pumps, purification systems and treatment plants operate only while Tetherwell grants access. Wealthy current-generation corporate design: brushed aluminum, carbon fiber, architectural white, graphite and black surfaces, precise seams, cyan instrumentation, drones, robotics and automated systems. Sleek and technologically dominant without borrowing the Launch-Shop's retrofuturist language.

BR_Dryline.text: THE DRYLINE REPORT — small, independent investigative journalism focused on water access, allocation records and the physical consequences of Tetherwell policy. Field-made and visually imperfect but rigorously sourced, technically competent and willing to scrutinize both Tethergrid and the Launch-Shop. Natural desert color, handheld evidence, direct equipment footage, restrained annotations and no sensationalist dystopian styling.

launch_shop.text: THE LAUNCH-SHOP — independent desert engineers launching a competing distributed network that can authorize and coordinate water equipment without Tethergrid. They oppose the monopoly, not conservation: their system must respect real aquifer limits while returning control to the communities whose wells, pumps and purifiers Tetherwell can lock. Maintained legacy aerospace, solarwave and rugged adventure design rather than junkyard improvisation.

tethergrid.text: TETHERGRID CORP — desert water-network monopoly and operator of Tetherwell; visually precise, clean, high-modern and technologically dominant, with brushed aluminum, carbon fiber and cyan system light.
